about_the_game:
Survive the Toonpocalypse!

You're the last hero standing against endless hordes of cartoon monsters! Choose your survivor, unleash a storm of absurdly powerful spells, and evolve your abilities to become an unstoppable force. In this action-packed roguelike, every run is a new adventure.  How long can you survive the chaos?

Features:

  • Choose Your Survivor: Unlock a diverse cast of unique heroes, from powerful Wizards to mighty Knights, each with their own signature abilities.

  • Evolve Your Arsenal: Start with a single spell and transform it into an unstoppable storm of destruction with hundreds of upgrade combinations.

  • Vanquish Vicious Bosses: Test your skills against massive boss monsters that will push your build to its limits.

  • Simple to Play, Hard to Master: Easy-to-learn controls make the action immediate, but deep strategic choices are required to conquer the highest difficulties. 

Add Toon Survivors to your wishlist and prepare for battle!

Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS / Ubuntu 20.04
  • Processor: Dual Core CPU, 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible, 1GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS / Ubuntu 22.04
  • Processor: Quad Core CPU, 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU, 2GB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
